lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\TextTemplates\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

Nothing in the app calls 2 routes outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates, in 13 files of the frontend source and in the navigation of info.xml. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).

lines: 2 uses in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated in Nextcloud 26 to 35. The text of the tag names the replacement where it has one.
lib/Controller/ConfigController.php:42 OCP\IConfig::setUserValue(): deprecated since Nextcloud 33; use IUserConfig directly
lib/Controller/ConfigController.php:53 OCP\IConfig::setAppValue(): deprecated since Nextcloud 29; Use IAppConfig directly

The app reads and writes its app config in 1 place and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
The app has 8 OCS routes and no openapi.json. Clients of OCS are generated from such a specification, and nothing else tells them what these routes take and return.
